confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Edinburgh price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are steadier than accommodation, which varies widely by date and may include Edinburgh's planned visitor levy from July 2026 (from general knowledge, not checked here). Cocktail and wine anchors use a beer-relative check because direct knowledge is weaker. Local prices were converted to USD at an assumed, unverified exchange rate. The only web searches run were for the RBA AUD rate; no city prices were searched.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Edinburgh city-centre price levels and Scotland's pricing, compared loosely with other UK heritage tourism cities such as York. July is peak summer demand but not the August Festival peak. No live comparison sites were used.
